info.name: Talk Enhancer (Fork by Sairento)
info.summary: Huriko Talk Enhancements: Atom One Dark syntax highlighting, smart paste, call protection & branding
info.description: Fork by Sairento for Huriko Cloud (cloud.huriko.com). Enhances Nextcloud Talk with: - Atom One Dark syntax highlighting for 190+ programming languages (Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, PowerShell, SQL, Bash, C++, Rust, Go, etc.) - Copy to clipboard button on every code block - Language badges (PYTHON, POWERSHELL, SQL, etc.) - Smart code paste that auto-detects code snippets and wraps them into markdown blocks - Default Original Image Quality for screenshots and diagrams (Issue #19616 / PR #19919) - File drag-and-drop fix ensuring original files are downloaded (Issue #1766) - In-call privacy protections preventing accidental mic leaks on close (Issue #2003) - Web hotkeys (M to mute, V for camera, / to chat)
info.author: Sairento / Huriko
